preconditions.description: The length of permutation a (n) and permutation b (m) must satisfy 1 ≤ n ≤ m ≤ 200000.
The length of permutation a must be exactly n.
The length of permutation b must be exactly m.
Permutation a must contain n distinct integers.
Permutation b must contain m distinct integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in a)
preconditions.description: All elements in permutation a must be integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= m for x in b)
preconditions.description: All elements in permutation b must be integers from 1 to m.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for d in range(1, m + 1) if all((x + d) in b for x in a))
postconditions.description: The output must be the number of distinct integers d such that the sequence c, where ci = ai + d for all i, is a subsequence of b.
